title: Shared contract definitions
description: Enums and reusable objects shared by the public scan API and the private assessment API. Enum values are stable: once emitted they are never renamed or removed, only added to.

task_id.description: Server-resolved task configuration. The caller names a task; it cannot supply the instructions, the target language, or the policy.

content_id.description: Caller-chosen identifier for one passage, echoed back on evidence so a quote can be traced to its source.

source_type.description: What the passage is, from the application's point of view. Never widens trust: every source_type is untrusted.

language_hint.description: Routing metadata only. An assertion by the caller, not a verified upstream result. Never bypasses, shortens or disables scanning, and never relaxes policy. Absent is valid.

label.description: The detector's assessment of the passage. Not a decision.

action.description: What the caller must do. CLIENT RULE: any value not recognized by the client MUST be treated as `block`. This lets the enum grow without breaking callers; `verify` is reserved for a future output-verification action and is never emitted today.

scan_status.description: `complete` means every accepted input character was included in the supported scan path. It does NOT mean the model understood the passage. Any value other than `complete` forbids a clean verdict.

category.description: Coarse reason the passage looked like task redirection. Advisory; the label and action carry the decision.

reason_code.description: Stable machine-readable explanation of the action, for telemetry and application branching.

evidence_item.description: An exact, bounded quotation from the original passage. The quote MUST be verified to occur in the referenced content before it is returned; fabricated quotations are rejected upstream of this contract.

coverage.description: Byte accounting for the scan. A response claiming scan_status=complete must report scanned == original and truncated=false; this is enforced by the response schema, not by convention.

versions.description: Identifies exactly what produced this result, so any outcome can be reproduced and attributed in an evaluation report.
